meta.source: research_notes/Emotion to activity evidence map/emotion_models_and_matching_logic.md (## Matching rules)
meta.warning: MOST COMBINATION RULES ARE EXTRAPOLATIONS. Of 30 rules, 18 are 'extrapolated', 9 'partly' tested and only 3 'directly_tested' (none of which is a pair rule). The notes state that no meta-analysis compares activity classes by emotion combination.

condition_grammar.all / any: list of sub-conditions; all must hold / at least one must hold
condition_grammar.{emotion, gte, lt}: score of that emotion id is >= gte and (if given) < lt
condition_grammar.{group, gte, lt}: max score over the emotion group (see emotions.json groups) is >= gte / < lt
condition_grammar.{signal}: boolean supplied by the app (persistent_severe_negative, self_harm_cue, severe_self_report)
condition_grammar.{selected_class}: true when the user picked an activity of that rule class

meta.evaluation_order: Highest priority first: R30 safety gate (100) > R01 intensity gate (90) > pair rules (60) > R27 mixed valence (50) > single-emotion rules (40) > R02 (10) > R28 (5) > R29 (1, always).

class_definitions.SENSORY: cold water, warm shower, senses-based grounding
class_definitions.MOVE-MOD: self-paced brisk walk, run, sport, dancing
class_definitions.PLEASANT: planned enjoyable or mastery activity = behavioural activation

restless_fallback.note: The notes contain NO single-emotion rule for 'restless' and no evidence rows targeting it. This fallback is a judgement call made in this dataset build (high-arousal-negative quadrant principle plus R18's direction), marked extrapolated.

rules.recommended_text: BREATHE, SENSORY, DISTRACT, MOVE-LOW first; cognitive options offered afterwards
rules.avoid_text: REAPPRAISE as the first step; focusing on the feeling
rules.rationale: People choose and benefit from distraction at high intensity, reappraisal at low intensity; concentrating on feelings d+ = −0.26
rules.citation: Sheppes et al. 2011; Webb et al. 2012

rules.app_note: Restricts the FIRST suggestion to these classes; cognitive or social options are offered as the follow-up.

rules.recommended_text: REAPPRAISE (perspective-taking), PLAN, plus any class allowed by the emotion's own rule
rules.avoid_text: Suppressing the feeling
rules.rationale: Cognitive change d+ = 0.36; perspective-taking d+ = 0.45; suppressing experience d+ = −0.04

citations_verification.matched_verification_record: Webb, Miles & Sheeran 2012, Psychol Bull 138(4):775-808

rules.app_note: Adds REAPPRAISE and PLAN to whatever the emotion's own rule allows. 'Suppressing the feeling' has no activity id; never prompt it.

rules.recommended_text: BREATHE, MINDFUL, MOVE-LOW (yoga), then REAPPRAISE
rules.avoid_text: Venting, punching, hard solo running, rumination
rules.rationale: Arousal-decreasing activities reduce anger (−0.63); arousal-increasing ones do not (−0.02); jogging tended to increase anger

rules.condition_text: Safety gate: extreme or persistent severe negative scores, or self-harm cues

rules.avoid_text: Any "fix it" activity list presented as sufficient; diagnostic wording
rules.rationale: App effects are small and harms under-reported; face-based emotion inference is unreliable, so escalate cautiously and let the user correct
